name: SGLang reports DeepSeek V4.1 Flash peak throughput up from 654K to 1.09M tokens per second per GPU in four days
title: SGLang reports DeepSeek V4.1 Flash peak throughput up from 654K to 1.09M tokens per second per GPU in four days
headline: SGLang hits 1.09M tokens per second per GPU
lede: SGLang now serves DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 1.09 million tokens per second per GPU peak total throughput, up from 654K four days earlier, and 943 tokens per second per user at concurrency 1.

effects.effect: Faster single-user responses help interactive agents
Lower serving cost for high-volume inference

appearances.title: SGLang reports DeepSeek V4.1 Flash peak throughput up from 654K to 1.09M tokens per second per GPU in four days
appearances.summary: The SGLang team says peak total throughput (cache hits, new input and output combined) on the AgentX workload rose about 67% over four days of optimization, and that a MegaKernel path reached 943 tokens per second per user at concurrency 1. No write-up or config is linked yet.
